<>Professionals
Project Manager (m/f/d) - Benelux

KHS is a subsidiary of Salzgitter AG. As one of the world's leading manufacturers of filling and packaging systems for beverages and liquid food we are a world-class player. Our customers have trusted in our passionate pioneering spirit and first-class technologies for over 150 years. However, we can only remain world class if we continue to find new employees who make just as high demands of themselves and the quality of their work as our customers make of us at KHS. Are you one of them?

Location: Breda

Your responsibilities:

- Overall project management for customer orders
- Responsibility for project success (costs, payments, deadlines and quality), as well as control and coordination of the project team and all interfaces
- Technical and commercial order clarification
- Commercial controlling of the project, deadline tracking and project reporting
- Change and claim management
- Evaluation of opportunities and risks (PRIP)
- Coordination of escalation management; resolution of conflicts
- Execution of project reviews and exchange of experience with stakeholders
- Preparation of the construction site phase as well as site control in close cooperation with the site manager
- Project control until defect-free handover to customer and after sales service

Your profile:

- A technology and/or business qualification (engineering or business administration)
- Several years of professional experience and a sound knowledge of project management methods and/or technical sales, where possible in the food/beverage industry
- You have knowledge of contract law
- You have user knowledge of SAP S4 Hana and MS Project
- You are fluent in spoken and written English and preferable German and French
- You have a targeted, structured manner of work
- You are able to work in a team, are assertive and possess good manners
- You have sound, efficient time management skills and can work flexibly according to project requirements
- Willingness to travel frequently and to spend longer periods abroad (approx. 25%)

Benefits:

- Innovative and international working environment
- Challenging and diversified job
- Working in a highly motivated team
- Strong company group
- Attractive remuneration
- Social benefits

In order to ensure our success in the future, too, we need first-class employees – and we also have plenty to offer them.

Apply now!
